title: agrostis castellana var. mutica
intro:
Agrostis castellana var. mutica, commonly known as Spike Fescue, is a type of grass that is native to the Iberian Peninsula and is often used in traditional medicine. This plant has been used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and inflammation, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis castellana var. mutica include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
